title: One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination
abstract: arXiv:2611.26336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hallucination research in low-resource languages fragments easily: each newly named failure mode prompts its own dataset, spending scarce annotators on incomparable resources. We argue for consolidation and test it at community scale. Alikbachan is a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along three crossed axes: a human-validated cultural-distance band, six task types, and a five-family, 32-mode hallucination taxonomy. It comprises a harvested 2,516-item test set (Phase 1) and a quota-constructed, gold-labeled 5,000-item set (Phase 2). The stratification is diagnostic. Four zero-shot LLM judges vary by over 30 macro-F1 points across strata, and the item-level predictions of 99 Phase-1 and 32 Phase-2 competition systems reproduce the profile: discourse-level omission defeats judges and most teams alike, whereas only a minority over-flag negative controls. The judges' verdict probabilities rank items well (ROC-AUC 0.74-0.

translated_title: 一个框架诊断一切：面向孟加拉语大语言模型幻觉的分层基准
translated_abstract: 低资源语言的幻觉研究很容易碎片化：每一种新命名的失败模式都会催生一个独立的数据集，使稀缺的标注资源被耗费在无法相互比较的资源上。我们主张对这些工作进行整合，并在社区规模上对此加以检验。Alikbachan 是一个孟加拉语幻觉检测基准，它沿三个相互交叉的维度进行分层：经过人工验证的文化距离区间、六种任务类型，以及一个包含五大类别、32种模式的幻觉分类体系。该基准包含一个采集得到的2,516条测试集（第一阶段）和一个按配额构建、经黄金标准标注的5,000条数据集（第二阶段）。这种分层设计具有诊断价值：四个零样本大语言模型评判器在不同分层之间的宏观F1分数差异超过30分，而99个第一阶段和32个第二阶段竞赛系统的条目级预测也复现了这一特征——语篇层面的信息遗漏让评判器和大多数参赛队伍都束手无策，而只有少数系统会在阴性对照上过度标记。评判器的判定概率能对条目进行有效排序（ROC-AUC 0.74–0.…）。
tldr: 本文提出孟加拉语幻觉检测分层基准 Alikbachan，通过文化距离、任务类型和32种幻觉模式三个维度交叉分层，并在社区竞赛中大规模验证，发现语篇级信息遗漏是零样本LLM评判器与参赛系统的共同弱项，证明了分层设计对模型幻觉能力的显著诊断价值。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Alikbachan, a Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark stratified along cultural distance, task type, and a 32-mode hallucination taxonomy, whose community-scale evaluation reveals that discourse-level omission defeats both zero-shot LLM judges and most competition systems, demonstrating the diagnostic value of stratification.
